messages:
emily: Heads-up — on the migration guide I clicked the 'anchoring' TOC link and it jumps to the very top of the page instead of the subsection. only on the deployed site, local preview is fine :disappointed: marc: url? sample link? emily: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/mdx-anchors#inline-code-example is the link I clicked. reproducer: open that page, click the third TOC item (Inline code example) -> lands at page top. luis: I ran linkcheck and it flagged a bunch of anchors as unreachable. looks like slug generation changed after the mdx frontmatter change in the last PR. linkcheck output excerpt: ``` ERROR https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/mdx-anchors#inline-code-example -> anchor not found, closest anchors: ["inline-code", "inline-code-example-1"] ``` emily: ah interesting — there used to be an explicit heading `### Inline code example` but in the MDX we added a leading HTML comment and `---` frontmatter, that might be stripping or renaming the slug. marc: MDX + docusaurus sometimes normalizes identical slugs by appending `-1` etc. if heading text or surrounding markup changed, anchor can move. quick options: 1) add an explicit HTML id on the heading 2) add a permalink alias in frontmatter or 3) update TOC link to match generated slug. dan: I'm happy to open the PR for option (1) — small patch, minimal surface area. would add `

Inline code example

` in that mdx file. emily: prefer avoiding raw HTML if possible. option (2) could be `---\nslug: mdx-anchors#inline-code-example\n---`? Not sure Docusaurus supports anchor aliases in frontmatter. luis: Docusaurus v3 supports `id` on markdown headings via `` right above the heading in MDX. e.g. ``` ### Inline code example ``` That keeps it MDX-native and avoids raw HTML. marc: nice — dan can you try that? also please rerun `yarn build && yarn linkcheck` locally. dan: will do. loading a quick patch now: ``` *** Begin Patch *** Update File: docs/migration/mdx-anchors.mdx @@ -### Inline code example + +### Inline code example *** End Patch ``` I ran `yarn build` and `./scripts/linkcheck.sh` and the failing anchor disappears. emily: can you include a short test step in PR description? steps for QA: click TOC link on deployed preview, should jump to section. dan: yep will include. assigning to @marc for review once CI passes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 docs-bot: deploy-preview created — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai/migration/mdx-anchors luis: i updated redirect mappings for the old anchor variants so external links won't 404 (`inline-code` -> `inline-code-example`). added a tiny redirect table in redirects.yaml. emily: awesome, thanks all :raised_hands: will smoke-test after preview is up. marc: LGTM after CI, merging once green. :thumbsup:
